title: Boxing
when: Bag classes since November 2025; competitive training at the Boxing Hall, Saroornagar Indoor Stadium, since May 2026
summary: Training mornings at six under Coach Gouni Kumar, sparring regularly, and aiming for the senior state competitions in Telangana in November 2027.
moment: My first spar: three rounds, two of them against a senior, and a bag had never taught me that the other person hits back. I walked out breathing hard, still buzzing, and sure I would be back the next morning.

title: Volleyball
when: Lala Lajpat Rai Hall of Residence, IIT Kharagpur
summary: Member of the gold-winning hall team in the Inter Hall Gymkhana Championship 2021-22.
moment: The last point of the Inter Hall final, 2021-22. Weeks of evening practice behind the hall came down to one rally, and the whole hall was on the sideline when it dropped.

title: NSS and volunteering
summary: Best volunteer of the gold-winning team at the NSS Annual Camp 2019 and part of the cloth-collection drive. Led the COVID fundraising campaign at GYWS in 2021 and conducted a tree plantation drive in Gopali village in 2022, planting 15 saplings.
moment: A villager in Gopali asking which sapling was hers so she could water it. Fifteen trees sounded small until each one had someone's name on it.

title: Guitar
summary: Self-taught on an acoustic: chords, a few fingerstyle pieces, and whatever friends ask for when one is around.
moment: Playing a half-learned song at a hostel gathering and having the whole room finish the chorus for me.
